sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dull occipital and frontal headache in after-
noon. Dull sensation over eyes. Eyeballs hot and hurt
when moved. Pupils dilated with headache.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Bloated feeling. Hungry sensation after
full meal. Great thirst. Constipacion.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Very tired and sore in lower limbs.
Feet burn. Knee-joints sore.

Sleep, —SL'Cpiness. Continuous dreaming.
